name: Rancho Cordova
seo_title: Rancho Cordova Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Rancho Cordova, California for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Rancho Cordova starts the season with a community tree lighting and fireworks, then adds a park district Santa breakfast and a miniature steam Santa Train.
celebrates: The Cordova Community Council leads the season with its annual Christmas Tree Lighting at Village Green Park, with music, Santa, a live nativity and food trucks. The Cordova Recreation and Park District follows with Breakfast with Santa, which pairs pancakes with a craft area and a holiday craft fair. The Sacramento Valley Live Steamers bring out a Santa Train on four December days, and the Rancho Cordova Arts group hosts a free Winter Art Fest at the MACC over two weekends. The city's own site says it hosts over 100 mostly free events a year.
lastyear: This year's tree lighting is the 27th annual, so last year's was the 26th, according to the Cordova Community Council. Visit Rancho Cordova describes breathless children waiting in line for a photo with Santa on the amphitheater stage while the sound of sheep drifts over from the live nativity. The tourism bureau also says regional neighbors call it the best Christmas tree lighting in the Sacramento area, a claim it makes for the tradition.
facts: The Sacramento Valley Live Steamers Railroad Museum started around 1965 and completed its track with a Golden Spike ceremony in 1973. Its main line is now over 6,300 feet long, and the American River passes within 100 feet of the railroad. The track is 7 1/2 inch and 4 3/4 inch gauge, with wooden trestles, a 40 foot truss bridge and a hill with twin waterfalls. The museum also brings a train to the tree lighting, according to its schedule.
trains: Rancho Cordova has one of the area's most unusual Santa trains. The Sacramento Valley Live Steamers Railroad Museum runs miniature trains through Hagan Community Park, and its Santa Train takes families to Santa's Oasis on December 5, 6, 12 and 13. For a full size excursion, the California State Railroad Museum in Old Sacramento runs The Polar Express Train Ride, which has its own listing in the Sacramento guide.

faq: When is the Rancho Cordova Christmas tree lighting in 2026?

The Cordova Community Council holds the 27th annual tree lighting on Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 4 to 7:30 pm at Village Green Park, 3141 Bridgeway Drive. The tree lighting and fireworks begin at 7 pm. Admission is free and the event includes pictures with Santa, a live nativity and food trucks.
Is there a Santa Train in Rancho Cordova?

Yes. The Sacramento Valley Live Steamers Railroad Museum runs a Santa Train on December 5, 6, 12 and 13, 2026, from 10:30 am to 2:30 pm, weather permitting. Trains leave Cordova Station and go through Hagan Park to Santa's Oasis. Tickets must be bought in advance online, and none are sold on the day.
Where can kids have breakfast with Santa in Rancho Cordova?

The Cordova Recreation and Park District holds its annual Breakfast with Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at the Neil Orchard Senior Activities Center, 3301 Dawes Street, with seatings at 9 and 10 am. Admission is $5 per person ages 2 and up, and reservations are required through the district.
Are there free Christmas events in Rancho Cordova?

The Christmas tree lighting is free to attend. The MACC Winter Art Fest is also free, running November 27 to 29 and December 4 to 6, though it is an art and gift festival rather than a kids event. The city says most of its more than 100 yearly events are free.
What else is near Rancho Cordova for Christmas?

Visit Rancho Cordova points families to Apple Hill for cut your own Christmas trees and to the American River Parkway and Hagan Community Park for a winter walk. Folsom, Citrus Heights and Sacramento also have their own Rally guides.
